title: James Harden Forced to Meditate on the Court After Brutal Officiating Pushes Him Over the Edge - NewsBreak
text:
By Shabiha Akter ,
1 hours ago
James Harden and refs (Photo By X/Fullcourtpass) The Cleveland Cavaliers have already been having a good season, and then James Harden joined the team to pair with Donovan Mitchell. Mitchell himself admitted that the Cavs’ ceiling shot up after Harden’s arrival .
Night after night, fans are now excited to witness the magic of the Harden-Mitchell duo. On Wednesday, the Cavs took the court against the Orlando Magic.
However, at one point during the game, the referees had Harden visibly frustrated. Harden had to take a moment to calm himself down and regain control of his emotions, perhaps after a call clearly upset him.
“ On my life, on my own life ,” Harden was heard saying.
Still, Wednesday’s game ended with the Cavaliers losing 128–122 to the Magic. Harden finished with 30 points on 11-of-16 FG, 5-of-9 from three, and 3-of-5 FT. He also added five rebounds and eight assists in 37 minutes. Mitchell contributed 25 points, five rebounds, and five assists in the loss.
Paul Pierce Breaks Down Clippers’ Style After James Harden Trade James Harden (Image Credits: Imagn) On the No Foul Given Show, Paul Pierce shared how the Clippers’ offense has evolved into a more balanced system even after losing James Harden.
“Originally, I thought when they traded James Harden in the middle of a great run they were on, that they were throwing in the towel. Then I look with the additions they got in Bennedict and Darius Garland. I actually like they way they play, the free-flow style play because before they was so dependent on James Harden’s pick and roll to make plays for pretty much everybody, and if he didn’t have it, he gave it to Kawhi. Were as now it’s more free-flowing; you don’t have Zubac clogging up the middle as much because now you have guys who spread around the floor around the perimeter that can knock down shots, ” he said.
After reviewing multiple trade scenarios , the Clippers surprised everyone by sending Harden to the Cavs. However, despite Paul’s take, the Clippers have not been having a smooth journey recently. The Clippers are now the No. 8 seed in the West, while Harden’s Cavs team sits at No. 4 in the East.
